revenueModel.text: RMR earns base management fees and incentive management fees under long term management and advisory agreements with the Managed Equity REITs, SEVN and other clients.
revenueModel.evidence: Alignment of interests also exists between us and our Managed Equity REITs due to the manner upon which we earn base management fees and incentive management fees under our management agreements with the Managed Equity REITs, as described in more detail below.
